description: Local readings and the explicit query keep repeat rule tags through recognition.
grammar:
%rule text {r} m :: ∅
%rule r q A :: T
%rule q ε
%conditions ¬$.starts-input ∨ $.starts-input
%rule m M
%check same #·m
%conditions $.preceding-element.local-readings, $.preceding-element.onward.parse({r} …),
  $.preceding-element.local-readings.tags = $.preceding-element.onward.parse({r} …).tags,
  $.preceding-element.local-readings.tags = T
%warning "same"
